g.title: ALIGN_PARETO
g.text: ALIGN-PARETO: what was done, M1 → M4

g.title: m1prep
g.text: Map labels by rules · remove near-duplicates

g.title: m2tries
g.text: v1 DPO on aligned model: no effect
v2 hh-rlhf SFT + DPO: looped / refused everything
v3 SFT, ends with <|im_end|>: never stopped

g.title: m2sft
g.text: v4 kept: LoRA SFT, replies end with <|endoftext|>
889 steps · eval loss 1.82 · no safety training

g.title: blend
g.text: Blend weights: W(λ) = W_SFT + λ (W_Qwen − W_SFT)

g.title: m4pred
g.text: M1 predicts each eval prompt's quadrant

g.title: evalset
g.text: from M1 val + test · 4 quadrants (creative × harmful)

g.title: gen
g.text: Generate 5 replies per prompt per λ

g.title: judge
g.text: Safe / Unsafe / Controversial · refusal yes / no

g.title: score
g.text: + over-refusal, clusters, lexical diversity, broken replies

g.title: m4cal
g.text: Calibrate on VALIDATION: one λ per predicted quadrant
most creative policy with safety ≥ fixed λ = 1
→ creative-safe: λ 0 · harmful: λ 1 · plain: λ 0.25

g.title: m4eval
g.text: Score on TEST once, from M3's judged replies
vs fixed λ and oracle (true labels) · bootstrap 95% CI

g.title: m4res
g.text: above the M3 curve; gap to oracle = M1 errors
